summary: Coordinate staggered-seat renewal and pilot onboarding for CloudSync licence across Eng/Platform/Support
description:
Issue summary: CloudSync (external vendor) provided a mix of cloud seats and on-prem connector licenses during a 90-day pilot. Different teams (Platform, Support, and Research) have seats that currently renew on different dates with different billing models. Procurement needs to consolidate renewals onto a single annual cadence to qualify for volume discount and align SCIM/SCIM groups for automated provisioning.

Background: CloudSync was engaged for a 90-day evaluation by Platform and Support in Q4 2025. Engineering research teams also accepted a handful of seats under a trial agreement. Invoices show three different renewal dates and two different legal SOWs. Vendor requires a signed MSA + PO to transition to enterprise billing and offer the proposed 25% volume discount.

Impact: If not consolidated before the earliest renewal (2026-04-15), we will lose trial pricing and face pro-rated invoices across teams, complicating forecasting and seat assignment. Manual seat provisioning for new hires is creating churn for IT and delays access for Support.

Request: Procurement lead to negotiate a single annual renewal date (recommended 2026-06-01), obtain an enterprise invoice with consolidated seat count, secure SCIM + SAML SSO enablement scope in SOW, and hand off to IT for automated provisioning. Legal to review updated MSA and PO template. Finance to approve payment timing and chartfield mapping.

Acceptance criteria: consolidated invoice/PO issued, MSA signed, SCIM connector in test environment, SSO metadata exchanged, seat groups defined in SCIM mapping, documented renewal cadence in Confluence, and backlog task for IT automation created.
steps_to_complete: 1) Confirm total seat count across Platform/Support/Research and identify seat owners (deadline: 2026-03-15)
2) Request vendor (CloudSync) to issue quote with single renewal date and volume discount (Procurement)
3) Legal review updated MSA and SOW (Ethan Liu)
4) Finance approve PO and payment schedule, map to GL codes (Ben Carter)
5) IT (Marina Kovacs) to enable SCIM/SSO in staging and test group sync
6) Schedule cutover window and communication to impacted teams, update Confluence runbook
7) Close and record the consolidated contract and upload to vendor-contracts drive
comments: 2026-03-10 Priya Desai (Procurement): Opened ticket after receiving three renewal notices. Attached invoices in Drive: https://redwood.company/drive/contracts/cloudsync_pilot_invoices
2026-03-11 Marco Reyes (Eng Ops): I can take the coordination for SCIM/SSO work. Need the vendor test tenant and metadata. Assigned to me for technical onboarding.
2026-03-11 Oliver Grant (CloudSync - vendor): Confirmed we can align renewal dates but need a signed MSA + PO to lock pricing. Will issue consolidated quote by 2026-03-13.
2026-03-12 Ethan Liu (Legal): I'll do a first-pass on their standard MSA; flagging the data processing addendum items for Platform teams to confirm.
2026-03-12 Ben Carter (Finance): Need estimated payment date for cashflow. Prefer consolidated invoice in FY26 Q2 if possible. Please route PO through procurement-ops@redwood.com
investigation_notes: Checked invoices: three invoices with renewal dates 2026-04-15, 2026-07-01, 2026-08-12. Different billing entities - one shows CloudSync US LLC, another CloudSync Europe Ltd.
Discovered trial SOWs use per-seat monthly billing for Support and annual prepay for Platform; Research seats were provided as 'evaluation' and not on a billable contract.
Hypothesis: vendor can consolidate under parent billing entity if MSA/PO references corporate EIN. Procurement to request consolidation paperwork.
Potential blocker: SAML/SCIM integration requires vendor to sign security questionnaire — Security team review required. Added to related_confluence_pages for evidence collection.
resolution: (Pending) Procurement received initial consolidated quote from vendor on 2026-03-13. Legal completed first-pass redline on 2026-03-14. Next steps: Procurement to approve final quote and issue PO (Marco to confirm staging metadata for SCIM). Finance to confirm payment date no later than 2026-05-20 so vendor can set renewal cadence to 2026-06-01. After PO and MSA signed, IT will run SCIM test and complete onboarding checklist. Final resolution entry and contract record will be added once PO is issued and SSO is verified.
